dest:gippsland-lakes:header.note: Aerial of the Gippsland Lakes meeting the ocean at Lakes Entrance, with Rigby and Fraser islands and the lake water spread across the frame. Lake-and-coast landscape, 3:2, subject near centre. Not on the photo-sources list, so flagged. Aerial is acceptable for a lakes header. Not a Commons file, so the GFDL 1600 px hit is not used.

spot:south-gippsland-1.note: Undertow Bay on the Cape Paterson to Inverloch coast: dune, surf and rocks, no people. It is the coast beside Inverloch, not the town itself, so it is a stand-in risk for the town spot; the judge decides. Landscape is 2.4:1, so a square crop keeps only the middle third (check the subject and zoom). Only landscape found on the official pages.
